proof_roadmap: Recall the morphism of topoi f_big and identify the lower shriek as right adjoint to the pullback.
Use the description of the lower shriek by sections and exactness of the pullback to verify the listed exactness properties.
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects exactness properties of the lower shriek f_! along a morphism of schemes, on the big Zariski, etale, smooth, syntomic and fppf sites (statement lines 6996-7037, a long statement with a displayed morphism). The proof recalls the description of f_big and the identification of the lower shriek as right adjoint to the pullback (proof lines 7039-7048) and then verifies the exactness properties by computing with sections and using the exactness of the pullback (proof lines 7048-7063). The non-formal content is the section-wise computation of the lower shriek. The claim is H2: one identification plus one verification from the section description.
